faqs.question: What makes Palamu Neuro & Eye Care the best neurology clinic in Jharkhand?
faqs.answer: Palamu Neuro & Eye Care stands out as a premier neurology center in Jharkhand due to several factors: it is headed by Dr. Yuvraj Lahre, one of the most qualified neurologists in the state with DM Neurology from AIIMS Bhubaneswar and a Gold Medal in MD Medicine; it offers comprehensive diagnostic services including in-house EEG; it provides personalized, evidence-based treatment across all neurological subspecialties; and it is centrally located in Palamu, the well-connected capital of Jharkhand.

faqs.question: What neurological services are available at this Jharkhand neurology clinic?
faqs.answer: Palamu Neuro & Eye Care provides a complete range of neurology services including consultation and treatment for migraines and chronic headaches, epilepsy and seizure disorders, stroke and post-stroke rehabilitation, Parkinson's disease and movement disorders, neuropathy and nerve pain, memory disorders and dementia, spine-related neurological problems, and carpal tunnel syndrome. EEG testing and coordination for advanced neuroimaging are available on-site.

faqs.question: Where is Palamu Neuro & Eye Care located and how do I reach it?
faqs.answer: Palamu Neuro & Eye Care is centrally located at Sitakunj police line road, Hamidganj, Medininagar, Jharkhand 822102, India. Palamu is well-connected by air (the nearest airport), rail (Daltonganj Railway Station), and road from all major cities in Jharkhand including Jamshedpur (~130 km), Dhanbad (~160 km), Bokaro (~110 km), and Hazaribagh. The clinic is open Monday to Saturday, 9 AM to 8 PM. Call 7779897207 for appointments.

faqs.question: Does the clinic treat patients from other states besides Jharkhand?
faqs.answer: Yes, Palamu Neuro & Eye Care serves as a regional neurology hub attracting patients from across Jharkhand as well as neighboring states including Bihar (Patna, Gaya), West Bengal (Purulia, Bankura), Odisha (Sundargarh, Rourkela), and Chhattisgarh (Jashpur, Raigarh). Dr. Yuvraj Lahre's AIIMS credentials and the clinic's comprehensive diagnostic facilities draw patients seeking specialized neurological care not readily available in their home districts.

faqs.question: What makes Palamu Neuro & Eye Care a leading eye hospital in Jharkhand?
faqs.answer: Palamu Neuro & Eye Care is among the leading eye care centers in Jharkhand, distinguished by Dr. Dibya Prabha's exceptional qualifications including MS Ophthalmology from RIMS Palamu, FICO (Fellow of the International Council of Ophthalmology), and a Retina Fellowship from the renowned LV Prasad Eye Institute Hyderabad. The clinic is equipped with advanced diagnostic technology including OCT, OCT-A, fundus photography, and visual field testing, enabling precise diagnosis and treatment of complex retinal and ocular conditions.

faqs.question: What eye treatments and surgeries are available at Palamu Neuro & Eye Care?
faqs.answer: Palamu Neuro & Eye Care offers a comprehensive range of eye care services including cataract evaluation and surgery with advanced techniques, diabetic retinopathy screening and retinal laser treatment, glaucoma diagnosis and medical management, age-related macular degeneration (ARMD) treatment with intravitreal injections, retinal detachment surgery, macular hole repair, ocular oncology evaluation, and routine eye examinations. Diagnostic services include OCT, OCT-A, fundus photography, and visual field testing.

faqs.question: How do I reach Palamu Neuro & Eye Care from different parts of Jharkhand?
faqs.answer: Our clinic is conveniently located in Medininagar, Palamu, and is well-connected by road and rail to neighboring districts. Regular buses and trains serve the area. The clinic is located at Palamu Neuro & Eye Care, Sitakunj Police Line Road, Hamidganj, Medininagar, Palamu, Jharkhand 822102. Please call 7779897207 to book your appointment in advance so we can guide you on the best route.

faqs.question: Does Palamu Neuro & Eye Care provide emergency eye care services?
faqs.answer: Yes, Palamu Neuro & Eye Care provides urgent and emergency eye care for conditions such as sudden vision loss, retinal detachment, acute glaucoma, eye trauma, and severe eye infections. While we recommend calling ahead at 7779897207, we prioritize emergency cases during clinic hours (Monday to Saturday, 9 AM to 8 PM). For after-hours emergencies, we can guide you to the nearest emergency eye care facility and coordinate follow-up care.
